articles.title: NATO is preparing for wars fought by swarms of THOUSANDS of AI-controlled drones which will rival nukes
articles.summary: A top NATO general disclosed preparations for future wars fought by thousands of AI-controlled drone swarms. The Russia-Ukraine conflict showcased the critical role of drones and AI, prompting NATO to adapt. This highlights the growing importance of advanced technology and autonomous systems in modern defence, demanding strategic integration and understanding of evolving warfare paradigms for SSB aspirants.

articles.title: Delhi High Court reaffirms AITA General Body's authority in constitutional amendments
articles.summary: The Delhi High Court has reaffirmed the All India Tennis Association's (AITA) General Body as the primary authority for amending its constitution. This directive mandates that all proposed constitutional changes must be presented to and approved by the General Body, strengthening democratic governance within the national sports federation. This ruling underscores judicial oversight in ensuring proper procedural adherence by national sports bodies.
